added.summary: An HLOD proxy carries a normal map: what its models' surfaces and normal maps show that its simplified surface does not (a wall's relief, a roof's ridges) is painted into a tangent-space page in the proxy's own MikkTSpace frame, so a distant town keeps its shading where it turns to proxies. Each proxy cooks one more texture, `<scene>#hlod-<n>-normal`; scenes with an `hlod` block cook their proxies again once.
